scope: Offline: both ToF grids re-cast at recorded sensor poses with and without the orchard's ground relief, and the Python reference gate replayed on each. A replay: only each capture's first difference counts. No simulator run has used the ground in the ToF mesh set.

kinds_of_change.ground_within_clearance_stops_earlier: the ground is nearer than the clearance limit and the hold comes earlier
kinds_of_change.blind_stop_removed_or_delayed: the trees-only hold was four blind cycles; the ground gives a return
kinds_of_change.hold_removed: no hold at all with the ground
